detailedNarrative: CASE020 (FIR/KOTWALIAMR/2025/0020) — Cyber Fraud (Online Investment Scam) registered at PS Kotwali Amritsar, Amritsar. Incident recorded on 2025-03-30 11:02 at Ranjit Avenue Residential, Amritsar. FIR records 2 accused (Monu Rana P00028, Rocky Sharma P00022) and 4 named persons in total. 869 records across 5 sources; 15 transactions flagged for review. Money-flow records show funds received and forwarded within minutes (e.g. EVD-TXN002899 → EVD-TXN002902, 47.0 min), a pattern that can indicate layering and requires verification. Account KKBK-16560494519 received funds from 3 different individuals within 14 days. Note: P00022 has a record 212.4 km from the incident location 155 min after the incident (EVD-LOC005905), which may be exculpatory and needs verification.
